comment: Pinned Sigstore verification policy shipped WITH this installer version. Changing it requires a new installer release.

sigstore._signer_note: Manifests are signed keyless by the protected public build-release workflow after it builds the pinned private source and verifies every artifact digest. The signature covers versioned manifest bytes; manifest.version == package.version prevents cross-version replay.

immutableOrigins._note: GitHub Release assets are the initial (deferred-object-lock) store. When an object-lock bucket is provisioned, replace this allowlist with the bucket host and enable write-once verification in release CI.
